bio: Light tempura fried in cottonseed oil. Commonly used fish are interspersed with inventive ingredients. Sea bream is wrapped in oba (perilla) leaves to infuse their aroma. Inspired by cutlet sandwiches, beef fillet tempura is served as a sandwich. Novelty and flexible thinking broaden the ways to enjoy the dining experience. Displayed on the wall is a calligraphy of the character for 'dragon', representing the passion to soar like an ascending dragon.
